content:
vivian: PM wants a punchy release note + tiny migration snippet for the new routing behavior. Deadline: merge by 2026-04-12.

chris: I can write it. What exact flag names?

marta: Eng: field is routing.prefer_latency (bool). Default false. When true, router prefers latency-optimized variants and falls back to cost-optimized ones. Streaming fallback may produce a brief partial chunk before full fallback response.

keegan: Suggested changelog blurb: "Latency-first routing (opt-in): add routing.prefer_latency to prioritize low-latency model variants. Existing integrations unchanged unless opted in."

chris: I'll add micro-migration with JS+Python snippets and a note about prefix cache impact. JS example:

```js
// JS SDK v2 — enable latency-first routing
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rwk-1', prompt: 'TL;DR this doc', routing: { prefer_latency: true } });
console.log(out.text);
```

chris: Python example:

```py
# Python SDK
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = c.generate(model='rwk-1', prompt='TL;DR this doc', routing={'prefer_latency': True})
print(resp.text)
```

marta: Add one-liner: enabling prefer_latency can route across model families and temporarily lower prefix/KV cache hit rate — expect small token-cost variance while caches warm.

keegan: Product wants rollout note: gradual 72-hour rollout with automatic rollback on error thresholds. Add support troubleshooting: if atomic streaming required, disable streaming or set retry_on_fallback.

release-bot: branch created refs/heads/docs/latency-first-2026-04-12 by chris (CI queued).

chris: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/538 — includes changelog blurb, micro-migration anchor /docs/migrate/latency-first-routing, snippets, and known-issue note. Tagging @marta for tech signoff and @keegan for copy.

marta: LGTM; clarified that partial chunk is typically <250ms.

keegan: minor copy tweak and will merge after green CI + staging preview.

vivian: thanks all — will notify CS once merged.
